shop._help: Products, prices and Stripe links now live in content/shop.json (edit them in the website admin).

contact_form._help: Optional. Paste a form endpoint (e.g. https://formspree.io/f/xxxx) to show an enquiry form on the Contact page. Leave blank to show phone/email only.

chat._help: Website chat assistant. With 'endpoint' blank it runs in TRIAL mode: instant answers from the FAQ and pages, no AI, no cost. To switch on the AI assistant, add ANTHROPIC_API_KEY to the eld-admin service on Render (see README) and put https://eld-admin.onrender.com/chat here
